isolation: Fresh saved-agent session per task; no repository or prior results supplied
submissionPolicy: At most two exact final replies, deterministic canonical feedback only after failure, same initial puzzle
comparisonGate: Both comparison rounds must exceed baseline maximum overall and on holdout; otherwise gain not shown
status: Three baseline rounds complete; original skill unchanged; no candidate evaluated yet
runtimeObservation: The UI labels iteration limit as a per-turn maximum. Empirically, sessions that reached the 12-iteration error rejected the subsequent feedback send before a second model reply. We recorded that error and ended the task unsolved; we did not raise the limit or start a fresh retry session for that puzzle. This is an observed continuation limitation, not a claim about the runtime implementation. Other infrastructure failures remain separate.
captureObservation: The UI whole-message Copy includes tool narration. Scoring instead captures the complete rendered final-answer body outside Agent steps; no JSON is extracted from prose. The full copied stream and expanded tool receipts are retained separately. An absent final body at budget exhaustion is recorded as an empty invalid submission.
evidenceFormatting: Trailing whitespace in AX text captures normalized for git. Exact scored final-answer strings remain in actual-replies.json, and whole-stream copies remain separately in assistant-stream.md files.
